description: This file defines the SugarCacheMemory class which extends the SugarCacheAbstract class. It implements an in-memory cache backend for the SugarCRM SuiteCRM system, providing methods for using the cache and stubs for external cache handling which are no-ops in this implementation.

classes.name: SugarCacheMemory
classes.description: A class providing in-memory caching implementation for SugarCRM, overriding methods to manage cache lifecycle and external cache interactions (which are no-ops in this case).

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating this cache backend is always available.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: A stub method meant for setting external cache data, does nothing as the cache is ephemeral.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: A stub method for retrieving external cache data, does nothing for this in-memory cache.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: A stub method for clearing external cache data, does nothing.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: A stub method for resetting external caches, does nothing.
